Best DDR4 & DDR5 RAM Upgrades for Gaming Laptops: Complete Installation Guide

Running a modern Windows 11 gaming laptop on single-channel 8GB RAM cripples your minimum frame rates by up to 30%. Upgrading to 16GB or 32GB dual-channel RAM is the single most cost-effective performance upgrade you can make.

🎯 Quick Buyer Verdict

Get the Crucial 16GB DDR5 5600MHz SODIMM for modern 2023-2026 laptops, or Crucial 16GB DDR4 3200MHz SODIMM for older DDR4 machines.
